versions.request: Provide, expand, or enhance child welfare preventive services
versions.explanation: Increase funding for preventive protective services for children.
versions.response: This request has already been completed. Explanation: ACS has been carefully monitoring the use of prevention services, which are critical to keeping children safe and families supported. ACS invests over $310 million in prevention services and our programs are available to families in every community district. Through slot adjustments, contract relinquishments, and terminations within the Family Services portfolio, ACS identified $8M million for Providers to reinvest in their workforce and implement strategies to meet families’ concrete needs. Providers were able to propose program or agency-wide strategies, and funds will be added to their contracts by the end of Calendar Year 2025. These investments are baselined and are in-line with our overarching goal: to serve more families more effectively in prevention services.
